source: RFC 7643 section 4.3 enterprise extension, as Entra sends it
expect_why: The Enterprise User extension is parsed onto the resource and stored per organization (migration 0187), so Entra's URN-qualified PATCH applies. This read 400 with the reason 'GAP: published in the schema document but not parsed onto the resource', which is the defect the extension work closed -- and the fixture NAMED FOR the extension asserting its own refusal is how a criterion stays unmet while its suite passes.
